v: tri॰ pra + anc + vic । pUrvadeSakAlavarttini । aYcernalopABAvAt Batve prAYca prAYcA ityeva ।
m: प्राञ्च् mfn. (fr. प्र + 2. अञ्च्; nom. प्राङ्, प्राची, प्राक्; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 182) directed forwards or towards, being in front, facing, opposite, RV.; VS.; AV.; Mn. (acc. with √ कृ, to bring, procure, offer, RV.; to stretch forth [the fingers] ib.; to make straight, prepare or clear [a path] ib.; [also with प्र-√ तिर्, or -√ नी] to advance, promote, further, ib.; with Caus. of √ कॢप्, to face, turn opposite to, Mn. vii, 189)
turned eastward, eastern, easterly (opp. to अपाच्, western), RV. &c. &c.
being to the east of (abl.), Mn. ii, 21
running from west to east, taken lengthwise, KātyŚr.
(with विश्वतः) turned to all directions, RV.
inclined, willing, ib.
lasting, long (as life), AV.
(esp. ibc.; cf. below) previous, prior, former
प्राञ्च् m. pl. (प्राञ्चस्) the people of the east, eastern people or grammarians, Pāṇ. i, 1, 75 &c.
प्राञ्जली-√ भू to stand holding out the joined and hollowed open hands, Kāraṇḍ.

s: tri, (pra + aYja + bAhulakAt alac .) saralaH । yaTA, -- “fjAvajihmapraguRO prAYjalaH saralo'pi ca । iti jawADaraH ॥
v: tri॰ pra + canja--alac । 1 sarale 2 suboDe ca jawA॰ ।
m: प्राञ्जल mfn. (prob. fr. प्र + अञ्जलि and = प्राञ्जलि) straight, Suśr.
upright, honest, sincere, ĀpŚr., Sch.
level (as a road), Kād.
प्राञ्जल—ता f. straightness, plainness (of meaning), Pañcat.

v: tri॰ prabadDo'Yjaliryena prA॰ va॰ । 1 badDAYjalipuwe prA॰ sa॰ । 2 badDAYjalO pu॰ ।
m: प्राञ्जलि mf(इ, ई)n. joining and holding out the hollowed open hands (as a mark of respect and humility or to receive alms; cf. अञ्जलि, कृताञ्ज्˚), Mn.; MBh. and &c.
प्राञ्जलि m. pl. N. of a school of the Sāmaveda, Āryav. (also -द्वैत-भृत्; v.l. प्राज्वलना द्वैत-भृतः and प्राजला द्वैत-भृत्याः).
प्राञ्जलिक (MBh.) = प्राञ्जलि.

v: tri॰ prAYjalirastyasya brIhyA॰ ini । badDAYjaliyukte striyAM NIp ।
m: प्राञ्ज˚लिन् (Hariv.) = प्राञ्जलि.
प्राञ्जलि—प्रग्रह mfn. holding the hands joined and outstretched, R. (v.l. ˚लिः प्रग्र्˚).
प्राञ्जलि—स्थित mfn. standing with joined and outstretched hands, ib.
प्राञ्जन (प्र-अञ्ज्˚), n. paint or cement (on an arrow), AV.
